name: Abla (Spain)
description: White field with a narrow green cross from edge to edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Abla (a castle on blue beneath red).
history: The municipality was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía to adopt its symbols in 1989 but did not do so until January 2007; the flag is described as a white rectangular cloth with a narrow green cross from edge to edge bearing the crowned municipal arms at the centre.
